items.action: Notice of proposed class prohibited transaction exemption.
items.summary: This document gives notice of a proposed class prohibited transaction exemption (PTE). This proposed QROAD class PTE (Proposed QROAD Class Exemption) would allow certain qualified professional asset managers (QPAMs) to continue relying on PTE 84-14, known as the QPAM Class Exemption, even after an event that would otherwise make them ineligible under Section I(g) of that exemption. To use this alternative path, the QPAM must comply with the protective conditions in this Proposed QROAD Class Exemption, if granted. This proposal does not change any fiduciary duties under ERISA section 404 or expand the relief available under the QPAM Class Exemption.
items.title: Proposed QPAM Re-Eligibility Options After Disqualification (QROAD) Class Prohibited Transaction Exemption
